spans.s:
m. (-न्तः)
The horizon.
E.
दिक्, and अन्त end.

n. (-रं)
Space, the atmosphere.
E.
दिक्, and अन्तर interval.

n. (-लं)
The sky, the atmosphere, space.
E.
दिक्, and अन्तराल interval.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Naked, unclad, unclothed.
2 Dressed in, or enveloped by the atmosphere, clouds, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 A Bauddha mendicant, wearing coloured clothes, or going naked.
2 Any mendicant not wearing clothes.
3

A name of ŚIVA, (from his being naked.)
5 A Jain of one great division, which represents the images of their saints, either naked or plainly attired.
f. (-री)
A name of DURGĀ. []
E.
दिक् inflection of दिश् space, अम्बर vestment; whose only garment is the atmosphere.

m. (-जः)
An elephant of a quarter or point of the compass, one of eight attached to the north, north-east, &c. supporting the globe.
E.
दिश् a quarter, गज an elephant.

m. (-हः)
Preternatural redness of the horizon, as if on fire.
E.
दिश्, and दाह burning.

mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
Smeared, anointed.
m. (-ग्धः)
1 A poisoned arrow.
2 A name of fire.
3 Oil, unguent, oily substance.
4 A tale, true or false.
E.
दिह to smear or anoint, affix क्त.

mfn. (-साः-साः-सः)
Naked.
m. (-साः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
दिक् for दिश् space, and बासस् vesture: see दिगम्बर.

m. (-यः)
Subjugation of an extensive country, either in arms or controversy.
E.
दिश्, and विजय triumph.

m. (-मः)
Invesion, going forth to conquer the world.
E.
द्विग्विजय, and क्रम march.

m. (-गः)
A quarter or point of the compass.
E.
दिक्, and विभाग division.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Famous, celebrated, known in all quarters.
E.
दिक, and विभावित made known.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
Spreading through all space.
E.
दिक्, and व्यापिन् what pervades.
